# QA catalogue

<!-- Generated by pnpm run docs:generate. Edit the implementation, then regenerate both audiences. -->

These are the checks Vortex's own end-to-end tests do not cover. When a change touches the Vortex files an entry guards, QA runs that entry. Each entry's needs are kinds of content from `doodlebot inventory`, never a named game or collection; an entry whose needs nothing meets is reported as not tested. An entry that only measures reports a measurement, never a pass. List the entries a change selects with `doodlebot qa list --touching <paths>`. This page is generated from `harness/qa/catalog.json`.

Vortex's own e2e specs, as of Vortex commit `acb3d86210`: `account-logout.spec.ts`, `account.spec.ts`, `dashboard.spec.ts`, `game-management.spec.ts`, `health-check-file-requirement.spec.ts`, `health-check-mod-requirement.spec.ts`, `health-check.spec.ts`, `login.spec.ts`, `mods-deploy.spec.ts`, `mods-disable.spec.ts`, `mods-manual.spec.ts`, `mods-uninstall.spec.ts`, `mods.spec.ts`, `profile.spec.ts`, `settings.spec.ts`, `smoke.spec.ts`, `upgrade-to-premium.spec.ts`, `view-profile-on-web.spec.ts`.

| Entry                        | Area          | Runs                                       | Passes when                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | Needs                                    | Cost    | Account | Network |
| ---------------------------- | ------------- | ------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ------- | ------- | ------- |
| `collections.scale`          | collections   | `doodlebot test collection-scale`          | No single main-thread freeze over 10 s in any phase of the install (and of the update with --update), and the review says complete.                                                                                                                                                                                                       | `sandbox`, `collection:offline`          | &lt;10m | no      | no      |

| `collections.nexus`          | collections   | `doodlebot test nexus`                     | Every required member of the collection installs, its deployed files match their SHA-256, and purge removes them.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | `login`                                  | &lt;10m | yes     | yes     |
| `downloads.churn`            | downloads     | `doodlebot test download-churn`            | Measured only; never a pass                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | `game`                                   | &lt;2m  | no      | no      |
| `mods.large-library`         | mods          | `doodlebot test large-library`             | At most 200 Mods rows rendered, clearing a filter blocks under 2 s, no blank rows at any depth, no task over 1.5 s across 10 installs, and a modern-layout deploy within 1.6 times the classic one.                                                                                                                                       | `sandbox`                                | &lt;10m | no      | no      |

## Why each entry exists and what it guards

### collections.scale

No Vortex e2e spec installs a collection, let alone one with thousands of members.

Guards (paths in the Vortex repository):

- `src/renderer/src/extensions/collections/**`
- `src/renderer/src/extensions/mod_management/InstallManager.ts`
- `src/renderer/src/extensions/mod_management/util/**`

### collections.download-retry

No Vortex e2e spec installs a collection or fails a download.

Guards (paths in the Vortex repository):

- `src/renderer/src/extensions/collections/**`
- `src/renderer/src/extensions/download_management/**`
- `src/main/src/downloading/**`

### collections.nexus

No Vortex e2e spec downloads and installs a real Nexus collection.

Guards (paths in the Vortex repository):

- `src/renderer/src/extensions/collections/**`
- `src/renderer/src/extensions/nexus_integration/**`
- `src/renderer/src/extensions/download_management/**`

### downloads.churn

No Vortex e2e spec measures what concurrent downloads cost persistence and the renderer.

Guards (paths in the Vortex repository):

- `src/renderer/src/extensions/download_management/**`
- `src/main/src/downloading/**`
- `src/main/src/store/**`

### mods.large-library

Vortex's mods specs use a handful of mods; none renders, filters or deploys a library of thousands.

Guards (paths in the Vortex repository):

- `src/renderer/src/extensions/mod_management/**`
- `src/renderer/src/controls/table/**`
- `src/renderer/src/controls/Table.tsx`
- `src/renderer/src/controls/VisibilityProxy.tsx`

### mods.scroll

No Vortex e2e spec scrolls the Mods table with real wheel input.

Guards (paths in the Vortex repository):

- `src/renderer/src/extensions/mod_management/views/**`
- `src/renderer/src/controls/table/**`
- `src/renderer/src/controls/Table.tsx`
- `src/renderer/src/controls/VisibilityProxy.tsx`

### plugins.page

No Vortex e2e spec opens the Plugins page; it needs a Bethesda game.

Guards (paths in the Vortex repository):

- `src/renderer/src/extensions/gamebryo_plugin_management/**`
- `src/renderer/src/controls/table/**`
- `src/renderer/src/controls/Table.tsx`

### plugins.mod-link

No Vortex e2e spec follows a plugin's Mod link to the Mods page.

Guards (paths in the Vortex repository):

- `src/renderer/src/extensions/gamebryo_plugin_management/views/**`
- `src/renderer/src/extensions/mod_management/views/**`

### bethesda.missing-masters

Vortex's health-check specs do not cover Missing Masters, a collection's check suppression or the game-version prompt.

Guards (paths in the Vortex repository):

- `src/renderer/src/extensions/health_check/**`
- `src/renderer/src/extensions/gamebryo_plugin_management/**`
- `src/renderer/src/extensions/collections/**`
